title: TickerTrail: Stock Watchlist Analytics
context: Retail investors track watchlists on trading apps. Simple analytics (best trade, spans, budgets) are classic array problems.
input: Daily closing prices per stock; two exchanges’ tick lists; a budget.

milestones.title: Spend a budget
milestones.requirement: Choose stocks (one share each) whose prices use a Rs 5 000 budget as fully as possible (subset sum).

milestones.title: Best single trade
milestones.requirement: Maximum profit buying before selling (running minimum).

milestones.title: Merge two exchanges
milestones.requirement: Merge two time-sorted tick lists into one timeline.

milestones.title: Price on a date
milestones.requirement: Find a trading day in the sorted date list (lower bound).

milestones.title: Stock span
milestones.requirement: Consecutive days ending today with price ≤ today.
